hook_text: The water in your glass today might once have been snow on the Drakensberg. How did it get to you?
clip_script: Meet a drop of water. Winter: it is snow on the Drakensberg. Spring: the Sun melts it into the Tugela River. Over the falls, all the way to the sea. The Sun heats the sea. The drop evaporates, invisible, rising up and up. High in the cold sky, it condenses with millions of others. A cloud! The drops join, get heavy, and fall as rain. Melt, evaporate, condense, freeze. Round and round, the same water, forever.
visual_style: Whiteboard landscape from the Drakensberg to the sea with arrows going up from the sea to clouds and down as rain, snow and rivers, looping round and round.
mood: Like an adventure story about one tiny drop.
pacing: Follow one drop up, across and down, naming each change of state as it happens.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and draw the water cycle from your own window.
